orchestrator_detail: orch-classifier x2 and orch-handler x1 all returned 'Task agent ... is not available'. Per the no-fake-pass rule, classify -> route -> handler -> merge was executed in the main thread and this routing map is the persisted classifier output. No subagent output was fabricated.

access.handler_spec: Build a stdlib-only beta control server owning share codes, session tokens, consent-gated collection and the update manifest; decide email auth; disable billing in the capability matrix.

landing.handler_spec: Classify all six landing variants, finalise the design from the initial version with a live conversational alternate, and produce the publishable site plus link.
landing.result: site assembled; variants mapped with confidence; BOTH landing designs live and smoke-tested. Public link NOT published: sites deploy returned SITES_APP_NOT_FOUND / retryable:false for deleted appId wbapp_3EiXiwaWSovkxwc1HX78j5 on three attempts. See PUBLISH_BLOCKER.md

distribution.handler_spec: Verify the self-contained bundle, gate downloads server-side, document the real cross-OS path, and implement remote update manifest + client checkers.
distribution.result: checksums verified; BetaUpdate.swift added and wired into LuminfestApp.swift; check_update.py shipped for the existing 1.4.0 bundle

webclient.handler_spec: Resolve the frontend brand to Luminest without touching internal identifiers, add PWA + production base path, and fix all defects found during beta prep.
webclient.result: 35 replacements, 0 residual; npm run build passes; 10 fixes recorded

items.B7: bundle downloadable / usable on another device, other OS and macOS versions, alongside the web version

decisions.email_auth: identifier-only, NO verification email; share code is the credential (Mailer has no SMTP on a small device)
decisions.billing: none; HARNESS_ALPHA_FREE=1 plus billing_required:false in the capability response
decisions.brand: Luminest for user-visible strings; internal identifiers preserved; one-command revert available
decisions.landing: initial version as default, ?variant=conversation as the live alternate (shipped site carries no third-party brand strings)
decisions.cross_platform: web version / PWA is the real path for iPad, Intel Mac, older macOS, Windows and Linux
